name: scm-js plugins
description: The plugins published by the scm-js project.

plugins.name: Hello World
plugins.description: An example plugin to copy from. It adds one Tools menu item that opens a small pane showing the name of the map you have open.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Melee Wizard
plugins.description: Builds a ladder-style map's bases in one action each: symmetric start locations for 2, 4 or 8 players, and mineral lines with the geyser laid out on the three-tile ring the game mines fastest from, mirrored to every player. Also mirrors what you select and checks the map's symmetry.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Paint
plugins.description: Drawing tools for the map. Draw lines, boxes, circles, freehand and text out of whatever the palette has picked, whether that is terrain, doodads, units, sprites or fog.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Repair
plugins.description: Checks a map file the way the game reads it when it opens — missing, damaged, repeated and oddly sized sections, header values the game cannot use, a stripped or stale ISOM — says what the game does with each, and repairs what you tick. The original file stays at hand until the next map opens.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: scmscx.com
plugins.description: Search scmscx.com, the StarCraft map archive, and open a map from it in the editor. The one item this plugin adds reaches scmscx.com over the network; its mark sits beside it.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Section Explorer
plugins.description: A hex editor that knows the map file. Every section of the scenario, its bytes, and what each byte is: records, fields, flags, and the names behind the numbers. Edit at the byte or at the field.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Terrain from Image
plugins.description: Turn a picture into terrain. Give it an image, say which colour means which terrain, and it lays out the map to match, cliffs and shores included.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Walkability
plugins.description: Reads the ground the way a unit does: islands, unreachable pockets, the areas a map divides into and the chokes between them with their widths, cliff seams with no ramp, and the ground distance between every pair of start locations, drawn over the map.
plugins.author: Jeany
